s.note: Rice balls brushed with miso and soy, grilled crisp over the coals. Four guards went to New York, four turtles came back in their armour.
s.how: Cook 2 cups short grain rice and cool until you can handle it. With wet salted hands, press into 8 firm triangles. Mix 2 tbsp white miso with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar. Grill the onigiri in a lightly oiled pan or on a barbecue for 4 minutes a side until crisp, brushing with the miso glaze in the last minute. Wrap the base of each in a strip of nori.

s.note: Chicken thigh and spring onion skewers grilled over coals, basted with soy and mirin tare. Uh, o-hi-o, wasabi.
s.how: Simmer 80ml soy sauce, 80ml mirin and 2 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy. Cut 600g chicken thighs into 3cm pieces and 1 bunch spring onions into 3cm lengths, and thread onto 12 soaked skewers. Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning and basting with the tare in the last 3 minutes.

m.note: Chicken, daikon, shiitake and cabbage simmered in kombu dashi with soy, a pot in the middle of the table. Sixty hours to get home, time for one hotpot.
m.how: Soak a 10cm piece of kombu in 1.5L water for 30 minutes, then bring to a simmer and lift it out. Add 3 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp mirin. Add half a daikon cut into thick half moons and simmer 10 minutes. Add 600g chicken thigh in chunks and simmer 10 minutes. Add 150g fresh shiitake, a quarter of a Chinese cabbage in wedges and 300g firm tofu in cubes and cook 5 minutes more. Finish with sliced spring onions and serve the pot at the table with rice.

w.n: Kinako dango with brown sugar syrup
w.note: Soft rice flour dumplings rolled in roasted soybean flour, dark brown sugar syrup poured over. For Splinter's Elvis at the end.
w.how: Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 80ml water for 5 minutes until syrupy and cool. Mix 200g glutinous rice flour with about 180ml water to a soft dough like an earlobe. Roll into 24 balls, press a dimple in each and drop into boiling water. Cook until they float, then 1 minute more, and lift into iced water. Drain, roll in 40g kinako mixed with 1 tbsp caster sugar, thread 3 to a skewer and pour the syrup over.

d.note: Roasted barley steeped and chilled, nutty and clean. I told you these disguises weren't gonna work.
d.how: Toast 60g pearl barley in a dry pan until dark golden, 8 minutes. Simmer in 1.5L water for 10 minutes, cool, strain and chill. Serve over ice. Or steep 4 roasted barley tea bags in 1.5L cold water for 2 hours.
